## Design decisions (ADR-074)
- **One shared base + three registered subclasses** (not one connector like ADR-071, because each OKC source is a distinct registry row with its own predicate surface named in `test_okc_slice_mapping.py`).
- **Reuse** the ADR-033-deferred parser layers (`parsing.tables`/`parsing.clauses`/`parsing.genre`); genre re-derived from text, no relabelling.
- **The Part VIII guard runs for every claim in `okc_claim`**: no plate/trip/per-person/per-search data (predicate+raw-value token scan + categorical exclusion), the officer-naming gate (default no-publish), and the sensitivity tier stamped (C1). A test fails if any prong is removed.
